Prostaglandins are a group of physiologically active compounds derived from arachidonic acid. by the action of COX enzymes.  They act as autocrine and paracrine factors with target cells in close proximity to site of secretion and have very short half-lives, they are present in almost every tissue in the body. 

Prostaglandins can have diverse actions, a given prostaglandin can have differing and even opposite actions in different tissues. depending on the receptor type involved.
